items.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: I got my conception of lead trumpet playing from three guys basically: From Conrad Gozzo and from Ernie Royal

ctx.x: Well you reached it, that’s for sure.

Well I don’t think I did but I mean I think for example, as I say, I’m doing this because it’s an educational thing, mainly, I’m letting some things out that I wouldn’t do in a normal interview. But I was always encouraged, although I didn’t have much confidence in it, a couple of my teachers really thought I could have been a fine classical trumpet player. I mean like major symphony level. But the thought of auditioning in that stuff always frightened me. I was actually asked to audition for a major symphony and…
I was hoping you’d say his name.
